name: Desk
tagline: Grades NFL player props and totals with its own probability read. Research, never picks
description: A research desk for NFL propositions. Name a player prop or a game total and it grades it using its own probability vocabulary, showing the reasoning so you can argue with it on paper. It deliberately stops at the research line: it never picks a side for you, and it never places anything on your behalf.
author: ConWanZo
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
